design_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HIGH CONTRAST TACTICAL FIELD UI
core_philosophy: Designed for one-handed outdoor phone usage with massive touch targets (min 48-56px), bottom sticky navigation bar, high contrast for sunlight legibility, minimal clutter, direct status color signals, and a clean professional desktop table view for business owners.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

colors.palette_mode: Light default with high contrast outdoor readability, support dark mode toggle

cta_buttons.primary_action: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold h-14 text-lg rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150
cta_buttons.whatsapp_share: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold h-14 text-base rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
cta_buttons.complete_job: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-extrabold h-16 text-xl rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150 w-full

one_hand_mobile_guidelines.bottom_nav: Sticky bottom navigation bar (Height: 64px, z-50) with 5 main destinations: İşler (Jobs), Takvim/Bugün (Today), Yeni İş (+ Big Center Action), Müşteriler (Clients), Rapor/Ayarlar (Owner Dashboard). Fixed to bottom on mobile (<768px).
one_hand_mobile_guidelines.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for buttons, inputs, and tab triggers. Primary CTA buttons set to 56px - 64px height.
one_hand_mobile_guidelines.thumb_zone: Keep primary completion actions, photo upload trigger, phone call trigger, and WhatsApp link generator near bottom of the viewport on mobile views.
one_hand_mobile_guidelines.desktop_adaptation: On screens >= 768px (md/lg), render a full sidebar navigation on left and expanded wide table views with multi-column filtering, bulk actions, and summary stats.

grids_and_layouts.mobile: Single column grid (grid-cols-1) with gap-4 and px-4 padding.
grids_and_layouts.owner_desktop_table: Full-width responsive tabular card container with horizontal scrolling fallback, clear column sorting, search filter bar, and status pills.
grids_and_layouts.public_service_form: Centered max-w-xl mx-auto py-6 px-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

visual_enhancers.sunlight_mode: High contrast 1px solid slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 borders, high contrast text (text-slate-900/white), distinct badge backgrounds, no soft low-contrast gray text.
visual_enhancers.photo_upload_preview: Grid of 2 high-contrast image drop zones for 'Önce (Before)' and 'Sonra (After)' service photos with camera tap trigger, thumbnail preview, image zoom overlay, and remove action.
visual_enhancers.whatsapp_card: Dedicated WhatsApp share card with auto-filled message template (Customer name, Job details, Total amount ₺, Public digital service form link).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL views are 100% in Turkish language with Turkish currency (₺) and Turkish date format (DD.MM.YYYY).
Implement full mobile-first sticky bottom navbar on phones (<768px) and standard sidebar navigation on tablet/desktop.
Make action buttons massive on mobile so field technicians (kombi, klima, tesisat, elektrik) can tap easily with one hand.
Support photo uploads for job completion (Önce / Sonra fotoğrafları) with preview, base64/file mock storage, and instant deletion.
Build the public digital service form view accessible via `/servis-formu/:id` with professional clean layout suitable for printing or customer review via WhatsApp.
Integrate Clerk/mock auth tabs seamlessly with onboarding (Firma Profil Oluşturma), Free (15 iş/ay) vs Pro (₺399/ay) subscription plan options.
Add explicit data-testid attribute to all interactive buttons, links, search inputs, tabs, status chips, and form controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
